metadata.tagline: Automate Your Workflows, Accelerate Your Growth
metadata.description: Founded in 2022, FlowSync is a SaaS startup helping mid-sized businesses automate complex workflows with easy, drag-and-drop integrations. The platform brings together tools like Slack, Salesforce, and Google Drive under a unified automation dashboard, enabling teams to save time and reduce errors. After gaining early traction with tech and marketing companies, FlowSync is poised for expansion and product refinement.

roadmap.narrative_description: Initiated a complete redesign of the dashboard interface based on customer feedback to improve usability and reduce onboarding friction.
Released the FlowSync Integration Marketplace, allowing third-party developers to submit new connectors and integrations for the platform.
Secured and successfully onboarded a Fortune 500 enterprise client, marking a shift from SMB to larger accounts and expanding product requirements.
Expanded the engineering and customer success teams by hiring 8 new employees, focusing on scaling product delivery and support.
Started the process toward ISO 27001 certification to meet enterprise security standards and build trust with larger clients.
Announced a Series A funding round, targeting $10M to fuel product development, sales expansion, and international growth.
Launched the public API, enabling customers and partners to build custom integrations and automate unique business processes.
Faced a supply chain issue affecting server hardware upgrades, requiring temporary performance management and customer communication.
Opened a sales office in Berlin to begin targeting European clients, with localization efforts underway for key languages.
Released the beta version of FlowSync’s mobile app, enabling users to monitor and trigger workflows on-the-go.
Successfully closed the Series A round, raising $11.2M and securing strategic investors from both the US and EU.
Hosted the first FlowSync Customer Success Summit, sharing best practices and gathering feedback for the next phase of product development.
